title: 第1章 天资妖孽李子夜第2章 冰清玉洁秦婀娜
content_zh:
;;
“秦仙子要来渝州城了！”
大商皇朝，渝州城，不知何方传来的一条消息，瞬间引爆了整座城！
“秦仙子？那个梅花剑仙？她来渝州城做什么？”
“当然是为了收弟子！”
多日来，不论说书人，还是城中权贵都谈论一个人。
秦婀娜！
说起秦婀娜，当真是说三天都说不完。
简单的说，美丽，强大，当世无敌。
如今，这般神仙般的人物要收亲传弟子，怎么能不让人疯狂。
但是，想要成为秦婀娜的弟子，不是十年，百年难得一见的天才，恐怕连想都不敢想。
三个月来，秦婀娜走遍了商朝十数城，依旧没有找到称心如意的人选。
这次来渝州城，更是只为一个人，传说中的绝世天才。
“在这九州之上，要说年轻一代的绝代天骄，有五人不得不提，那便是佛门的佛子三藏，神殿的神子燕小鱼，朱雀宗的圣女火麟儿，还有我大商皇朝的四皇子慕白，可惜，这四位都已经有了师承。”
渝州城，最大的酒楼内，一位手拿折扇的说书先生唾沫横飞，四周的桌上，不少客人听得津津有味，大都是往来的客商，来酒楼暂时歇脚，顺便听听城中的风土人情。
“说书的，你刚才不是说有五人吗，这才四个啊。”一旁的桌上，一位汉子开口，问道。
“别急。”
说书先生喝了一口茶，道，“你们可知道，我们大商朝最大的商号是谁家吗？”
“这谁不知道，渝州李家，号称富可敌国，这和你说的有什么关系。”汉子不爽道。
“当然有关系，还有大关系。”

说书先生脸上露出一抹意味深长的笑容，道，“李家家主李百万有一个儿子，名为李子夜，那可是不输给佛子三藏，神子燕小鱼的绝世天才。”
“吹吧你就。”
另一边的桌上，一位读书人嗤之以鼻道，“佛子三藏，神子燕小鱼是什么样的人物，李家的那个李子夜如何与他们相提并论。”
“我可没有瞎说，剑痴你知不知道。”
说书先生鄙夷地看了一眼读书人，道，“据说，剑痴前些日子来渝州城时，李百万想要让自己的儿子拜其为师，但是，那位剑痴看过李家的李子夜后，直接拒绝了，而且只说了一句话。”
说到这里，说书先生故意停了下来，卖了一个关子。
周围的听书人立刻被吊起了胃口。
剑痴他们知道，也是商朝有名的剑道高手，为人嗜酒，嗜剑，名气极大。
隔壁桌的汉子有些急了，扯着嗓子问道，“别卖关子了，那位剑痴说了什么？”
另一边，读书人也竖起了耳朵，等待答案。
说书人见所有人都被吊起了胃口，这才满意地喝了一口茶，缓缓道，“剑痴说，李家儿郎有剑仙之姿，我之愚剑，不配为其师。”
一语落，周围众人哗然。
酒楼前，一位衣着锦绣衣衫的年轻人听到里面的言语，停下了脚步。
“三皇……公子，这些说书人都是哗众取宠之辈，李家是商贾之家，哪可能出什么剑道奇才，待秦剑仙来到渝州城，以公子武道之姿，定然能顺利拜在秦剑仙门下。”锦衣年轻人身边，一位小厮开口，恭维道。

"Fairy Qin is coming to Yuzhou City!"
In the Great Shang Dynasty, Yuzhou City, a piece of news came from nowhere, instantly detonating the entire city!
"Fairy Qin? That Plum Blossom Sword Fairy? What is she doing in Yuzhou City?"
"Of course it's to recruit disciples!"
For many days, both storytellers and dignitaries in the city have been talking about one person.
Qin Graceful!
Speaking of Qin Grace, I really can't finish it in three days.
Simply put, beautiful, powerful, and invincible.
Nowadays, when such a god-like figure wants to accept a direct disciple, how can we not make people crazy?
However, I am afraid that I would not even dare to think about becoming Qin Grace's disciple, a genius who is rare to see in a hundred years or not in ten years.
In the past three months, Qin Wanna visited more than ten cities in the Shang Dynasty, but still could not find a satisfactory candidate.
This time I came to Yuzhou City only for one person, the legendary genius.
"Above the Nine Provinces, when it comes to the peerless geniuses of the younger generation, there are five people who have to be mentioned. They are Tripitaka, the son of Buddhism, Yan Xiaoyu, the son of the temple, Huo Lin'er, the saint of the Suzaku Sect, and Mu Bai, the fourth prince of my Great Shang Dynasty. Unfortunately, these four have already learned from their disciples."
In the largest restaurant in Yuzhou City, a storyteller with a folding fan in his hand was spitting. Many customers on the tables around him were listening with great interest. Most of them were businessmen who came to the restaurant to take a rest and listen to the local customs of the city.
"Storyteller, didn't you just say there were five people? This is only four." A man on the table nearby asked.
"Don't worry."
The storyteller took a sip of tea and said, "Do you know who is the largest business house in our Shang Dynasty?"
"Who doesn't know that the Li family in Yuzhou is said to be as rich as the country? What does this have to do with what you said." The man said unhappily.
"Of course it does matter, and it does matter a lot."
A meaningful smile appeared on the storyteller's face and he said, "The head of the Li family, Li Wanwan, has a son named Li Ziye. He is a peerless genius who is not inferior to Sanzang, the son of Buddha, and Yan Xiaoyu, the son of god."
"Just blow it."
On the other side of the table, a scholar sneered and said, "What kind of person are the Buddhist disciple Sanzang and the divine son Yan Xiaoyu? How can the Li Ziye of the Li family compare with them?"
"I'm not lying, Jian Chi, do you know that?"
The storyteller glanced at the scholar with disdain and said, "It is said that when the sword idiot came to Yuzhou City a few days ago, Li Wanwan wanted his son to become his disciple. However, after the sword idiot saw Li Ziye of the Li family, he directly refused and only said one sentence."
At this point, the storyteller deliberately stopped and let it slip.
The appetites of the listeners around him were immediately whetted.
They knew that Jian Chi was also a famous swordsman in the Shang Dynasty. He was addicted to alcohol and swords, and was extremely famous.
The man at the next table became a little anxious and asked in a loud voice, "Stop being so pretentious, what did that sword idiot say?"
On the other side, the scholar also pricked up his ears, waiting for the answer.
Seeing that everyone's appetites were whetted, the storyteller took a sip of tea with satisfaction and said slowly, "The sword idiot said that the son of the Li family has the appearance of a swordsman, and my stupid sword is not worthy of being his teacher."
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone around him was in an uproar.
In front of the restaurant, a young man in brocade clothes stopped when he heard the words inside.
"Three Emperors... Young Master, these storytellers are all sensationalists. The Li family is a family of merchants. How can there be any swordsman wizards? When Qin Jianxian comes to Yuzhou City, with the master's martial arts skills, he will definitely be able to become the disciple of Qin Jianxian smoothly." Beside the young man in Jinyi, a servant said complimentarily.
